notes:
CRM notes and call snippets:
- Overview: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building an in-product assistant + support agent. Currently running a Hosted API POC; strong interest in moving to Dedicated (VPC) for data residency and latency SLAs.
- POC summary: using Hosted API for embeddings-driven search + chat. Early results: relevance hit-rate 72% on test prompts, chat p95 latency ~300ms with bursty traffic; single-region hosted env fine for MVP. Engineering reported token costs trending higher than spreadsheet target -> exploring batching + caching recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
- Security / compliance asks: Nimbus requires SOC2 Type II report or equivalent attestation, SSO/SAML integration for RBAC, audit log retention policy (7+ years preferred for some lines of business), KMS integration for key control, and strict data residency within US regions. Legal: "cannot send PII outside VPC; need contractual clause and proof of isolation."
- Dedicated/VPC requirements discussed: private control plane + VPC peering, optional on-prem connector for very sensitive workloads, ability to pin model versions and fallback policies, support for customer-managed KMS. Network team wants sample network diagram, egress rules, and port/IP ranges.
- Pricing / commercial: leaning toward a committed Dedicated contract if we can hit latency SLOs and provide SOC2 + SSO. Price sensitivity moderate-high; prefer blended committed rate with trunk capacity and overage pricing. Forecasting $60k-$150k ARR depending on committed throughput.
- Technical preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models with deterministic outputs for support flows; want automatic fallback to cheaper variant if Dedicated capacity saturated. Latency target: p95 chat <250ms in primary region; throughput target: sustained 120-150 req/s during peak.
- Quotes / call snippets:
  - "We need the SOC2 paperwork before we can put this in front of procurement." (Legal lead)
  - "If Dedicated gives predictable latency and cost, we can commit for 12 months." (CTO)
- Next actions: AE to upload SOC2 artifacts and completed security FAQ to Drive (done 2026-03-03 draft), SE to prepare network diagram and SSO integration plan, schedule VPC peering walkthrough w/ Nimbus infra (target 2026-03-10).
- Risks: Legal block on SOC2, network team's calendar slippage, potential additional controls requested (data retention rules) that increase implementation time.
